thread:
Maggie: Heads up — after last night's ATS import a bunch of candidate 'sourcing_source' values got swapped (referral <-> direct). Dashboards show several recruiters credited incorrectly. Can we pause analytics and backfill?
Samir: Yikes. Do we have a quick sample ID list so data can validate?
Maggie: Sample IDs: 56321, 56322, 56323, 56359. Looks like ~1.2k rows affected across last 30 days.
Dena: Thanks. I can run a check. Quick SQL to confirm counts:```SELECT sourcing_source, COUNT(*) FROM candidates WHERE created_at > '2025-11-01' GROUP BY sourcing_source;```
Samir: If it's a straight value swap we can run a reversible update:```UPDATE candidates SET sourcing_source = CASE WHEN sourcing_source='referral' THEN 'tmp_direct' WHEN sourcing_source='direct' THEN 'referral' WHEN sourcing_source='tmp_direct' THEN 'direct' END WHERE created_at > '2025-11-01' AND sourcing_source IN ('referral','direct');``` We'll keep a transaction and a dump first. @Dena can you review?
Dena: I can review. My worry: UI exports (used for hiring managers) already pulled wrong recruiter attribution. Need a backfill for recruiter_id too in some cases, not just sourcing_source.
Maggie: Correct — noticed recruiter attribution mismatches on a subset. Might be a joined mapping in the import script.
Samir: Ok two-step plan: 1) Pause analytics pipeline and the daily ATS->BI export (so reports don't keep spinning). 2) Run validation query and a dry-run update, capture affected candidate ids to a file, then run update + backfill for recruiter_id where mapping exists. 3) Re-run analytics backfill.
Jules: Flagging hiring managers who pulled csvs yesterday — they should avoid re-sending candidate packets. I'll draft a short note. :warning:
nats-sync-bot: ats-sync-bot detected 47 recent sync failures between 02:30-03:15 UTC. Error: "mapping conflict: unknown source value 'referral_v2'"
Dena: That error matches the import logs — source enum changed upstream. We'll add a guard in the import to coerce legacy values.
Samir: Can someone grant me DB write window? I'll plan for 11:30 UTC run (low traffic). I'll also prepare a rollback script using the saved IDs.
Maggie: Approving the window. Also pls include a short changelog entry for hiring-ops-notes so we can reference the root cause in postmortem.
Dena: Running dry-run now, will paste sample diffs in a sec.
Samir: Perfect. Once we have the diffs, I'll post the update script and estimated runtime.
Maggie: Thanks team. After backfill, let's schedule a brief retro to add schema validation to the import pipeline and a unit test for enum mismatches.
Jules: I'll coordinate manager comms and let CS know in case any candidate-facing links got affected.
Dena: Dry-run done — 1,217 rows affected. Sample diff:
```- id: 56321, sourcing_source: 'direct'
+ id: 56321, sourcing_source: 'referral'
```
Samir: Looks good. Posting update script in #eng-db and scheduling the window.
Maggie: Great. Please tag me when it's complete. :thumbsup:
